stem_book: Four point masses P, Q, R and S with respective masses 1 kg, 1 kg, 2 kg and 2 kg form the corners of a square of side a, taken in order P, Q, R, S around the square. The centre of mass of the system will be farthest from (a) P only (b) R and S (c) R only (d) P and Q
work: P(0,0),Q(a,0),R(a,a),S(0,a): y_cm = (2a+2a)/6 = 2a/3, x_cm = a/2 ⇒ nearer RS, equally farthest from P and Q (corner order assumed, added to stem)
